name: design-judge-skills
tagline_zh: 投奖总陪跑？让 Agent 用证据链拆解评委口味，从作品集到申报表，逐项打分预演，连获奖理由都替你写好。
tagline_en: Tired of award rejections? This Agent dissects jury taste with evidence, scores your entry, and drafts winning.
desc_en: Evidence-driven Agent Skills for design award research, evaluation, award matching, entry writing, and submission readiness.
why_zh: 同类只给模板，它用可复现的评分矩阵和获奖案例库，把玄学评审变成可查证的差距清单。
why_en: Unlike generic checklists, it builds a reproducible scoring matrix from real winning cases, turning jury taste into a verifiable.
